function.name: search_google
function.description: Performs a search query on Google and returns a list of URLs that match the search criteria. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term to query on Google.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. The number must be a positive integer.

language.description: The language for the search results.

filter.description: A flag to filter explicit content in search results.

date_range.description: The date range for the search results in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY-MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, searches across all dates.

message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick overview of some of the most prominent vaccine manufacturers around the world. Let me know if you’d like more detail on any particular company, their product pipelines, or recent news.

| Company | Headquarters | Notable Vaccines (COVID‑19 & others) | Key Highlights |
|---------|--------------|--------------------------------------|----------------|
| **Pfizer‑BioNTech** | New York, USA / Mainz, Germany | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – COVID‑19; HPV vaccine (Gardasil 9) | First mRNA COVID‑19 vaccine approved worldwide; strong partnership between a pharma giant and a biotech startup. |
| **Moderna** | Cambridge, USA | mRNA‑1273 (Spikevax) – COVID‑19; RSV vaccine (mRNA‑1345) | Pioneer in mRNA platform; rapid development and large-scale manufacturing capacity. |
| **Johnson & Johnson (Janssen)** | New Jersey, USA | Ad26.COV2.S (J&J COVID‑19) | Single‑dose adenovirus‑vector vaccine; also produces vaccines for Ebola, meningitis, etc. |
| **AstraZeneca** | Cambridge, UK | AZD1222 (Vaxzevria) – COVID‑19; HPV vaccine (Cervarix) | Uses chimpanzee adenovirus vector; global distribution agreements. |
| **Novavax** | Gaithersburg, USA | NVX-CoV2373 (Nuvaxovid) – COVID‑19; influenza vaccine (FluBlok) | Protein subunit platform; high efficacy in trials. |
| **Sinovac Biotech** | Beijing, China | CoronaVac – COVID‑19; Hepatitis B vaccine | Inactivated virus platform; widely used in many countries. |
| **Sinopharm (Hepatitis B & COVID‑19)** | Beijing, China | BBIBP-CorV – COVID‑19; various hepatitis B products | State‑owned manufacturer; large domestic market. |
| **Bharat Biotech** | Hyderabad, India | Covaxin – COVID‑19; various inactivated vaccines | Indigenous vaccine platform; significant domestic production. |
| **Serum Institute of India** | Pune, India | Covishield (AstraZeneca‑Oxford) – COVID‑19; multiple other vaccines | Largest vaccine manufacturer by volume; produces >100 million doses annually. |
| **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** | Brentford, UK | Shingrix (herpes zoster), HPV vaccine (Gardasil 9) | Strong portfolio in recombinant protein vaccines. |
| **Sanofi Pasteur** | Lyon, France | Fluzone (influenza), HPV vaccine (Gardasil 9) | Global vaccine division of Sanofi; focus on influenza and other viral diseases. |
| **Merck KGaA (MSD)** | Darmstadt, Germany | MMR, Varicella, HPV (Gardasil 9) | Long‑standing history in vaccine development. |
| **CureVac** | Tübingen, Germany | CVnCoV (COVID‑19) | Non‑modified mRNA platform; early‑stage clinical pipeline. |
| **Biontech (now part of Pfizer)** | Mainz, Germany | BNT162b2 (Comirnaty) – COVID‑19 | Early partner in mRNA vaccine development. |
| **Eli Lilly** | Indianapolis, USA | None (focus on therapeutics) | Not a vaccine manufacturer, but involved in vaccine research collaborations. |

### How to Use This List
- **Research**: If you’re looking into investment, partnership, or regulatory approvals, start with the companies that have the most relevant product pipelines.
- **Supply Chain**: For procurement or logistics, note the geographic spread—some manufacturers have regional facilities (e.g., Serum Institute in India, Sinovac in China).
- **Technology Platforms**: mRNA (Pfizer, Moderna, CureVac), adenovirus vectors (AstraZeneca, J&J), inactivated virus (Sinovac, Sinopharm), protein subunits (Novavax).

Let me know if you’d like deeper insights into any of these companies, their financials, recent press releases, or upcoming vaccine candidates!
